title: Dutch Local Election Study 2018 (DLES/LKO 2018)
descriptions: The Dutch Local Election Study 2018 has been an enterprise of the Foundation of Electoral Studies in The Netherlands (Stichting Kiezers Onderzoek Nederland; SKON). The data were collected within the LISS-panel collected by CentERdata. Data are archived by CentERdata, and can be accessed there. https://www.dataarchive.lissdata.nl/study-units/view/1223 https://www.dataarchive.lissdata.nl/study-units/view/1225
